title: Client Partner
description:
**Role: Client Partner - Growth & Business Development**

Location: [Delhi, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Ahmadabad]

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports To: [Sales Manager]

Experience: 1-3 years

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a motivated Client Partner to join our growing sales team. This is a ground-floor opportunity for someone who wants to build a long-term career in business development and leadership. As a client Partner, you will identify new business opportunities, build strong client relationships, present our services, and convert prospects into long-term customers. High performers will follow a structured growth roadmap toward a State Head leadership role within approximately one year, based on defined performance milestones.

Client Partner roles typically involve new-business development, client relationship management, sales-cycle ownership, and revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, contact, and qualify prospective clients through field visits, calls, referrals and digital channels.
* Understand client requirements and recommend suitable products or services.
* Prepare and deliver clear presentations, proposals, and quotations.
* Build trust-based, long-term relationships with clients and decision-makers.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.

**What We Offer**

* Manage the complete sales cycle: prospecting, follow-up, negotiation, closing, and onboarding.
* Maintain accurate client records, pipeline updates, and sales reports in the CRM.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth service delivery and client satisfaction.
* Represent the company professionally in the market and protect its brand reputation.
* Participate in sales reviews, training sessions, and business-planning meetings.
* Market-standard fixed salary, paid on time.
* A clear and transparent incentive structure, explained before joining.
* Family trips and recognition rewards based on target achievement.
* Health insurance coverage for employees, as per company policy.
* Sales training, product training, CRM tools, and continuous coaching.
* A defined career roadmap from Client Partner to Senior Client Partner, Team Lead and State Head.
* A performance-driven culture where achievement is recognized and rewarded.

**Career Growth Roadmap:**

Client Partner → Months 0–3 → Training, market onboarding, pipeline building,

initial closures

Senior Client Partner → Months 4–8 → Consistent target achievement and stronger client

portfolio

Team Lead / Assistant State Head → Months 9–12 → Territory ownership, team support, revenue accountability

State Head → 12+ months → State-level strategy, team leadership, and market

expansion

*Promotion to State Head will be based on achievement of revenue, client-acquisition, consistency, and leadership readiness milestones. \**

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is confident, disciplined, and genuinely interested in building a sales career.

**Education**

* B.Sc. in Computer Science is preferred.
* MBA in Marketing or a related field is preferred.
* Candidates with equivalent qualifications and relevant sales, business development, marketing, or client-facing experience may also apply.

A background in computer science, business, marketing, or a related discipline is commonly preferred for client facing and business-development roles; MBA qualifications are often listed as preferred rather than mandatory.

**Experience**

* 1-3 years of experience in sales, business development, client servicing, marketing, or customer relationship management.
* Prior experience in IT services, software, digital solutions, consulting, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

**Skills Required**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to understand client needs and offer suitable solutions.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and comfortable with field work.
* Basic knowledge of CRM tools, MS Office, and email communication.
* Willingness to learn about technology-driven products and services.
* Professional appearance, positive attitude, and strong follow-up discipline.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Building a healthy pipeline of qualified prospects.
* Converting leads into paying clients.
* Maintaining strong relationships with existing customers.
* Meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly targets.
* Growing into a leadership role through consistent performance.

**How to Apply**

**1. Apply Through Our Website**

* Visit www.aasint.com
* Open the Careers section.
* Select the Client Partner job posting.
* Follow the application instructions.

**2. Apply by Email**

* Send your updated CV/resume to hr@aasint.com.
* Subject: Application - Client Partner - [Preferred City]
* Include a short note about your skills and experience.
* Freshers with strong communication skills are welcome.
* Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by HR.

*T&C\*: Preference will be given to candidates who are currently residing in the city for which they are applying.*

Pay: ₹350,000.00 - ₹450,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Delhi, Delhi

title: Technical Account Manager - OpenShift
description:
**About the Job:**

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) delivers strategic technical and architectural guidance along with hands-on technical support to key customers, enabling them to optimize their Red Hat infrastructure. This role cultivates strong relationships, develops deep technical expertise of customer environments and exercises good judgment to make informed decisions that impact customer success. The TAM is responsible for working independently with minimal instruction to resolve moderately complex technical issues. This role proactively coaches customers on best practices for utilizing Red Hat solutions, anticipates and mitigates potential customer challenges, serving as a trusted advisor and advocate for assigned accounts. The TAM demonstrates a solid understanding of customer business needs and technical environments, contributing significantly to customer success and retention.  
  
**Note:** This role may come into contact with confidential or sensitive customer information requiring special treatment in accordance with Red Hat policies and applicable privacy laws.

**What You Will Do:**

  

* Proactively identify and address potential technical risks within customer environments.
* Develop and support the implementation of solutions for complex technical challenges.
* Provide hands-on support to the assigned customer
* Collaborate with engineering and product management teams on customer escalations.
* Conduct regular technical reviews with customers to ensure optimal performance.
* Develop and maintain deep technical expertise in assigned Red Hat products.
* Serve as a technical mentor for junior team members.
* Contribute to the development of best practices and internal training materials.
* Conduct regular account reviews with customers and internal stakeholders.
* May be required to work on customer site and connect to customer systems.

**What You Will Bring:**

  

* 6+ years of experience working in a support, development, engineering, IT, or quality assurance (QA) organization
* Experience in Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP) or Kubernetes or Dockers cluster management
* Understanding of RHOCP Architecture & different types of RHOCP installations  
  Experience in RHOCP Troubleshooting and data/logs collection
* Strong working knowledge of Prometheus and Grafana open source monitoring solutions will be considered a plus
* Administration experience of Red Hat OpenShift v4.x will be considered a plus
* Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
* Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with shifting priorities and timelines
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers both clearly and concisely
* Ability to travel for customer visits and events within the region
* Comprehension of continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) concepts

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. * Basic understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing

* Basic knowledge of Computers.

  
**Behavioural Skills**  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good at building and leveraging relationship.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong Decision making skills.

 **Additional Information**

**About the Department**  
**Global Generics India**  
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  
  
**Benefits Offered**  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  
  
**Our Work Culture**  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

title: Editorial Services Director
description:
**Company Description**

Informa is a leading academic publishing, business intelligence, knowledge, and events business, creating unique content and connectivity for customers all over the world. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a member of the FTSE 100.

Taylor & Francis is one of the world’s largest publishers of high-quality, peer reviewed scholarly journals, books, e-books and reference works. We empower learners, thinkers and doers with trusted knowledge that advances research and enriches lives. We bring together diverse people, ideas and opinions to validate and publish the experts, theories and truths that matter. And we’ve been doing this in an unbroken arc since 1798.

Our purpose is to foster human progress through knowledge. We strongly believe that this requires us to encourage and examine different ideas and voices, so that any work that meets our exacting levels of quality deserves to be included in our publications. This requires open minds, the opportunity for robust debate, and the courage to defend perspectives that stand up to scrutiny, even if they conflict with our personal beliefs or values. Because that’s the only way to find the best obtainable version of the truth and, ultimately, foster human progress. If you agree, then we’d love to hear from you.

 **Job Description**

Reporting to the VP of Strategic Programmes & Delivery, the role holder is accountable for the strategic direction, service performance, successful development and day to day operations of the Editorial Services function, in order to drive and deliver centralised processes in a standard, efficient manner.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Design and deliver strategic direction for the Editorial Services function providing clear business planning and objectives for the team on e.g. process and efficiency improvements and customer satisfaction for Editors.
* Ensure effective and consistent service delivery across the Editorial Services function, establishing appropriate service levels and performance measures and maintaining oversight of operational performance, quality, capacity and customer experience to ensure services meet agreed business needs.
* Maintaining a strong leadership presence and being an exemplar role model of high standards.
* Provide oversight of service performance and operational risks across Editorial Services, working with Editorial Services Managers to address performance issues, capacity constraints and service risks, and escalating or initiating corrective action where required.
* Maintain oversight of demand, capacity and capability across Editorial Services, ensuring resources are aligned to business priorities and taking action to address material or emerging service risks.
* Define the governance arrangements for process and efficiency improvements for Editors in close liaison with the Head of Programmes & Process Improvement and Books Editorial Directors.
* Use service performance data, customer feedback and operational insight to identify opportunities for continuous improvement, ensuring that changes deliver measurable improvements in service quality, efficiency and customer experience.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders in the business to ensure process and efficiency improvement strategies for Editors are understood, that stakeholders are engaged through all parts of the operational excellence process, and that the work supports the wider business strategy and priorities.
* Deliver effective change management through active engagement with the business and use of change management techniques working closely with business stakeholders to provide effective solutions to overcome challenges and resistance to change.
* Assess the expected outcomes and estimated benefits of process improvement programmes and projects, and track business and financial impacts against these objectives.
* Proactively monitor the progress of initiatives, resolving issues and initiating appropriate corrective action, supporting and empowering the Editorial Services Managers to clear blocks to progress.
* Provide strong coaching style leadership to the Editorial Services Managers with a particular focus on coaching for process improvement and agile skills to ensure that process improvement delivery standards and good practices are adhered to and that process improvement progress is clearly communicated to stakeholders.
* Working closely with the VP of Strategic Programmes and Delivery to develop strategies and plans to develop the Editorial Services team in line with business demands
* Take the lead on large, strategic or more complex project work as required.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (or very experienced Green Belt already working towards Black Belt level).
* Trained in Agile methodologies.
* Specific qualification in project management or project methodology

**The ideal candidate will have:**

* Demonstrated experience in managing process delivery teams, preferably at an Academic Publishing Organisation.
* Understanding of processes involved in managing improvement/ change projects, programs and portfolios.
* Demonstrated experience of managing large and/or complex change projects.

Establish a proactive engagement rhythm through monthly and quarterly business reviews, cost-anomaly monitoring and regular value-realization discussions.

Support the Sales organization by building the customer satisfaction, adoption and service foundation that enables renewals and expansion.

Strong practical understanding of AWS cloud billing and cost management, including Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, AWS credits, invoicing and the AWS support/case process.

Experience building or improving SOPs, service playbooks, knowledge bases, SLA frameworks, KPI dashboards and operational processes.

Experience driving proactive customer engagement, platform adoption, optimization initiatives or customer-value programs.

Excellent communication, customer management, problem-solving and cross-functional leadership skills.

Willingness to work from the Noida office five days a week.

AWS Partner organizations, Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and cloud resellers.

FinOps, cloud cost optimization and cloud management platform companies.
